pins.title: Cooling Mattress Pad for Hot Flashes: 3 Picks by Night Sweats and Washing
pins.subtitle: Heat under your back and hips?
pins.description: Waking around 3 a.m. with heat pooled under your back and hips and a damp sheet beneath you? A mattress pad won't stop a hot flash, but a good one may help the bed surface feel cooler, and a waterproof layer can keep sweat out of the mattress. This buyer's guide compares three picks by how far your sweat goes and how often you want to wash: a moisture-wicking pad, a thin phase-change pad, and a waterproof terry protector. Based on manufacturer specs, not medical advice. Read the full guide. #coolingmattresspad #hotflashes #nightsweats #menopausesleep #hotsleeper #sleeptips

pins.title: Cooling Mattress Pad vs Waterproof Protector: SLEEP ZONE vs Slumber Cloud Core vs SafeRest
pins.subtitle: Which layer do your nights need?
pins.description: Not sure whether you need a cooling mattress pad or a waterproof protector? SLEEP ZONE: a fiber-filled pad whose fabric the manufacturer describes as moisture-wicking and fast-drying, machine wash cold, tumble dry low, not listed as waterproof. Slumber Cloud Core: a 0.25-inch pad with phase-change Outlast fabric that keeps your mattress's feel, but the manufacturer suggests washing it only 2 to 4 times a year. SafeRest: not a cooling product, a terry protector with a waterproof membrane backing, per the manufacturer, for sweat that soaks through. See the full comparison table in the guide. #coolingmattresspad #mattressprotector #nightsweats #hotflashes #hotsleeper #beddingguide

pins.title: Cooling Mattress Pad Layering for Night Sweats: An Easier 3 a.m. Sheet Change
pins.subtitle: Swap one layer, not the whole bed
pins.description: Tired of stripping the whole bed in the dark? One common layering order, bottom up: mattress, waterproof protector, cooling pad, then a thin fitted sheet. With a protector underneath, a damp night often means swapping just the sheet. Keep a spare fitted sheet ready, and keep the top layers thin, since a thick quilted cover can keep the cooling fabric from reaching your skin. Follow each manufacturer's instructions and check that your sheets still fit. See the layering section in the guide. #nightsweats #coolingmattresspad #bedroomsetup #hotsleeper #menopausesleep #sleeptips

pins.title: Cooling Mattress Pad Checklist: 6 Things to Check on the Listing Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Read past the product name
pins.description: Save this before you shop for a cooling mattress pad. 1) Mattress thickness and pocket depth, including any topper. 2) Care instructions: washer- and dryer-safe, or meant for only a few washes a year? 3) Waterproof, cooling fabric, or both? Read the description, not just the name. 4) No "heated" or "electric" in the name. 5) Return window and seller, since a manufacturer's own return policy may not apply on Amazon. 6) Review count and model, since some brands list several versions under similar names. Full checklist in the guide. #coolingmattresspad #buyersguide #hotflashes #nightsweats #hotsleeper #beddingtips
